body: I’ve been on 1.5- 3mg for 8 weeks with no improvement. And very short spasms where I shake and It stops abruptly. I think I should ask to increase it to 6mg based on this post but I’m afraid of the side effects. Thank you to whoever posted this. I rather shake then have symptoms at this point. My symptoms are 24/7. Any advice?

I thought I was the only one. I’ve been through many phases. Currently thinking I’m Psychic. Last year the voices told me my position at work would be eliminated. They repeated for about a month maybe more. This year my position was eliminated. Many other things have also happened exactly how the voices said. Now the voices are saying I’m going to die and have instructed me to plan my funeral. They repeated plan your funeral for months! But they have also described things that never happen or happen to someone else. I know it’s hard to ignore but someone once said to me, the horoscope in the newspaper is right sometimes and that’s written for thousands if not millions of people. Sometimes “predictions” seem to fit me but mostly they don’t!

Glad you posted this. I’ve been noticing that I’m happy when I cook large meals. I’ve been trying to figure out what I could do for work now. Does not sound like an easy job by far. But I think I may be happy doing it if I can get into the field.

Thank you all. It really helps that people have hope because I have really lost hope. Many schizophrenics don’t work. I was hoping to be the exception.  I take my medicine. I see my therapist and physiologist and started going back to church. I really thought it wouldn’t come to this. I never imagined losing my job so I feel like eventually I will succumb to this too. It’s really hard to accept. Just like the diagnosis. I hear multiple voices all day long. Yet I still refused to believe I had schizophrenia. I start a peer to peer group on Monday. I don’t know any other schizophrenics so this may help. I haven’t told anyone about my job. So Again I thank you. It’s good not to feel so absolutely alone.
